clue.text: Caught in test, taken in by bowling? On the contrary, it's disputed

parts.note: C is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught
on can mean in, as in 'on the team'

indicators.note: taken in by says one piece is enclosed by the other
on the contrary flips the order of containment, so the bowling goes inside the test

parts.note: a trial is a test
overs are spells of bowling in cricket, six balls each

explanation.surface: A cricket commentary about a catch in a Test match, leading to a disputed decision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the contrary' flips the containment just described: the bowling goes inside the test, not the test inside the bowling. 'test' and 'bowling' paint Test cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: Something controversial is argued about, so a disputed matter is the same thing.

clue.text: Financially safe, having been supplied with base metal?

definitions.meaning: an idiom for thoroughly reliable, especially as an investment

definitions.text: having been supplied with base metal?
definitions.meaning: literally, given a bottom of copper, a base metal, as ships' hulls once were

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom comes from ships sheathed below the waterline in copper, which made them sound and dependable.

clue.text: Statesman on top of the world

definitions.meaning: Lord ... was the British Prime Minister during the American War of Independence
the top of a map or globe is the northern direction

explanation.definitionFit: Lord North was an eighteenth-century Prime Minister, and maps put the northern pole at the top.

clue.text: Muted music in instrumental part

indicators.note: in places the music inside the instrumental part

parts.note: a reed is the vibrating part of a woodwind instrument
a strain is a passage of music or a melody

explanation.surface: A soft passage of music played within a woodwind section.
explanation.definitionFit: Muted and held back are both senses of subdued or controlled.

clue.text: Old soldier needs to check time with new

parts.note: to vet is to check or examine
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A former soldier must keep up with the times and new developments.
explanation.definitionFit: A veteran is someone who served long in the forces, an ex-serviceman.

clue.text: Solitary confinement for heartless criminal in new exploitation

indicators.note: in puts the reduced criminal inside the new exploitation

parts.note: reuse is making use of something again, a fresh exploitation

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle of the word criminal, keeping its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A heartless crook is sent to solitary confinement in a fresh abuse of the system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solitary confinement' reads as one phrase, but only 'Solitary' is the definition, a noun meaning a hermit; 'heartless' keeps only the outer letters of criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: A solitary, as a noun, is a hermit who lives alone, apart from society.

clue.text: Cooled down, having gambled capital away

indicators.note: capital is the first letter of the word, and away says to drop it

parts.note: diced means gambled with dice

explanation.surface: Someone calmed down after gambling away their money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like money lost in gambling; here it is the initial letter of DICED.
explanation.definitionFit: Iced food or drink has been chilled, made colder.

clue.text: One may get a haul in it at sea in Baltic area

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A fishing boat can land a good haul in the Baltic.
explanation.definitionFit: The country lies on the eastern shore of the Baltic Sea, one of the Baltic states.

clue.text: Lad had early run, developing act in America

indicators.note: developing means evolving into a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boy had an early run at performing, building up a stage act in the USA.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous comedy double act made its films in Hollywood, America.

clue.text: Like mistletoe held up by host?

definitions.text: Like mistletoe held up by host?

parts.words: Like mistletoe held up by host?
parts.note: mistletoe grows on and feeds off a host tree, which holds it up; the host also suggests a party host holding mistletoe aloft

explanation.definitionFit: Mistletoe draws nourishment from the tree it grows on, living off another organism.

clue.text: Film actor's run not a hit

definitions.meaning: a background performer in a film crowd scene
in cricket, a run scored without the batter hitting the ball, such as a bye or wide

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean something added beyond the main event: a non-speaking film performer, and a bonus run in cricket.

clue.text: A number in hospital that's sky-high?

definitions.meaning: number read as numb-er, something that numbs, an old anaesthetic
the upper regions of the sky, the clear heavens

explanation.definitionFit: The anaesthetic numbs patients, and in poetry it names the upper air of the heavens.

clue.text: Start flight with incomplete journey plan

indicators.note: incomplete says the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: a route is the planned way for a journey

explanation.surface: Begin a trip with only part of an itinerary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' suggests air travel; here it means fleeing, and to rout an army is to put it to flight.
explanation.definitionFit: To rout an enemy is to defeat it so it scatters in retreat, putting it to flight.

clue.text: Sign of contentment from queen, perhaps

definitions.text: Sign of contentment from queen, perhaps

parts.words: Sign of contentment from queen, perhaps
parts.note: a queen is a female cat, and a contented cat makes a low rumbling sound

explanation.definitionFit: A cat's low vibrating sound shows it is happy.

clue.text: He tries to put off rate increase with rebate initially

parts.note: tempo is a rate or speed
a rise is an increase

indicators.note: initially takes just the first letter of the word rebate

explanation.surface: A man tries to delay a rate rise by offering a rebate first.
explanation.definitionFit: A temporiser stalls and delays decisions to gain time.

clue.text: Strong point of wine bottled in good French environment

indicators.note: bottled in says the wine is enclosed within the other piece

parts.note: bon is French for good
Asti is an Italian sparkling wine

explanation.surface: A stronghold of wine kept in bottles in pleasant French surroundings.
explanation.definitionFit: A bastion is a fortified projection, a stronghold.

clue.text: House colours presented in intervals

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house, one sharing a wall with its neighbour, common in Britain
tones are shades or colours

explanation.surface: House colours are on show during breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'House colours' suggests a school house's uniform; SEMI is the British semi-detached house.
explanation.definitionFit: Semitones are the smallest musical intervals in Western music.

clue.text: Unchanging rental renegotiated after first quarter

indicators.note: says the rearranged word comes after the compass quarter, which comes first

parts.note: E for east, one of the four quarters of the compass

indicators.note: renegotiated means rearranged on new terms, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A rent that stays fixed even after the first quarter's renegotiation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'renegotiated' rearranges the six letters of rental, and the compass quarter goes in front of them.
explanation.definitionFit: Something everlasting never changes.

clue.text: Artistic medium in a tantrum at first

indicators.note: at first says the tantrum goes before the a

parts.note: a temper is a fit of anger, a tantrum

explanation.surface: An artist's paint is mixed in the middle of a fit of rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Tempera is a paint bound with egg yolk, used by painters.

clue.text: Weapon giving first-class support to a leading vessel, say

indicators.note: a leading says the a goes in front
in a down clue the support is underneath, at the end

parts.note: SS is a steamship
eg, for example, is what say means
A1 means first-class, here A and I

explanation.surface: A weapon gives top-quality protection to the lead ship.
explanation.walkthrough: First-class is A1, with the digit read as the letter I. In a down entry, 'support' means it sits at the bottom, under the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a light spear used in southern Africa.

clue.text: Justify one's involvement abandoned plot

parts.note: ex means former, cast off

indicators.note: involvement says the one is wrapped up inside the plot

parts.note: a plan is a plot or scheme
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone must account for their part in a scheme that was dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain one's conduct is to give reasons for it, to justify it.

clue.text: Getting to plane before nightfall

definitions.meaning: making level or smooth, as a carpenter's plane does
the time of day as darkness comes

explanation.definitionFit: Levelling a surface is making it flat, and the close of day is the time when night falls.

clue.text: Elects leaders of opposition party, they say

indicators.note: the leaders of the words are their first letters

explanation.surface: A party chooses the leaders of the opposition, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'they say' looks like a sound signal, but it simply supplies two more initials.
explanation.definitionFit: To elect is to choose, and to choose is to take a pick.

clue.text: Man, possibly, found in Memphis leisure centre

indicators.note: found in says the letters are tucked inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A man was spotted at a leisure centre in Memphis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is the Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is an example of an island.

clue.text: Fabulous bird hot in pursuit to catch a fish

indicators.note: in pursuit says the hot follows behind the bird
to catch says the letters close round the a

parts.note: the roc is a giant bird of Arabian legend
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A legendary bird swoops hotly in pursuit of a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: The roach is a freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Yeast fermenting still

indicators.note: fermenting means bubbling and churning, so the letters are stirred up

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means up to now or so far, as in 'not done yet, still'.

clue.text: Run and hide

definitions.meaning: to rush along quickly, to dash
an animal's skin with the fur on

explanation.definitionFit: To dash along is one meaning, and an animal's skin with fur is the other.

clue.text: Fellow's name that is used after some hesitation

indicators.note: used after says the name and that-is follow the hesitation

parts.note: er is a sound of hesitation
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A man's name only comes out after some faltering.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name stands for a fellow, a male person.

clue.text: One disputing accounts showing profit before disastrous years

indicators.note: before puts the profit ahead of the rest

parts.note: gain is profit

indicators.note: disastrous means wrecked, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Someone questions accounts that showed a profit before years of disaster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One disputing accounts' is the definition, not part of a business story; 'disastrous' scrambles the letters of years.
explanation.definitionFit: To gainsay is to contradict or deny, so a gainsayer challenges what is claimed.

clue.text: Modelling session given publicity by artist in good position

parts.note: a sitting is a session posing for a portrait
PR is public relations, publicity
William Etty was an English painter of nudes

explanation.surface: A model's session publicised by a painter puts her in a fine spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means well placed or comfortably off.
